<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Hexalith.Memories.Mcp</id>
    <version>2.27.1</version>
    <authors>ITANEO</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Memories</projectUrl>
    <description>MCP Server surface for Hexalith.Memories (LLM agent interface — Phase 1.5). Exposes
      search_memory / ingest_content / traverse_relations / get_case_info tools over the Streamable
      HTTP transport defined by the Model Context Protocol. Story 10.1.</description>
    <tags>hexalith memories mcp modelcontextprotocol llm agent dapr</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Memories" commit="d54dba5be30a3626e871b4fc56dd78e76a7acf71" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Hexalith.Memories.Client.Rest" version="2.27.1" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hexalith.Memories.Contracts" version="2.27.1" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hexalith.Memories.ServiceDefaults" version="2.27.1" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Hexalith.Memories.Telemetry" version="2.27.1" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Dapr.AspNetCore" version="1.18.5" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Dapr.Client" version="1.18.5" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer" version="10.0.11" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore" version="2.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
    <frameworkReferences>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <frameworkReference name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.App" />
      </group>
    </frameworkReferences>
    <contentFiles>
      <files include="any/net10.0/appsettings.Development.json" buildAction="Content" />
      <files include="any/net10.0/appsettings.json" buildAction="Content" />
    </contentFiles>
  </metadata>
</package>
